correctness.rationale: The weak-pseudocomplemented negation from Chen 3.1/3.3 is antitone, disjoint, inflationary under double negation, hence a symmetric loop-free graph polarity. Conversely N_G is a symmetric irreflexive polarity and the explicit lift satisfies P1–P5 (crucially P5 via X=U\C subset A\T and N antitone), ID, semicomplementation, double inflation. MP/normality follow from N(X union Y)=N(X) cap N(Y) and X cap N(X)=empty. Nonedge singleton witnesses negate NI; full graph reduces to classical implication. 266376 directly rechecked finite input triples across 75 graphs, but proof is uniform.

value.rationale: Motivated structural classification: every graph polarity occurs as F-preconditional negation on a fixed Boolean lattice, in contrast to previously characterized chains whose F-negation is unique. The MP-and-normal explicit lift exhibits non-Heyting conditionality on distributive carriers; the NI iff complete theorem establishes a natural sharp extra-axiom boundary. It is not an arbitrary small enumeration.
